kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
wire.summary: Drone makers are testing new, big drones that can deliver water or fire retardant with AI assistance. Aspen, Colorado is the first place trying them out. Cool and expensive? Yes. Effective? TBD.

wire.title: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
wire.summary: The U.S. has skipped a key U.N. human rights review for the second year running. Rights groups warn the absence risks undermining global accountability.

wire.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
wire.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

wire.title: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
wire.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

wire.title: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
wire.summary: Little is known about her except that she's reportedly about 13 and named Kim Ju Ae, but Korea's spy agency says she's likely her father's heir.

wire.title: Indonesia's VP offers resignation as questions mount over his eligibility
wire.summary: His resignation offer comes amid a widening political rift between Prabowo and Widodo and a separate investigation into allegations that senior police officials wiretapped the president.

wire.title: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
wire.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

wire.title: Seven days of chaos in the ER: How this country's healthcare system is unraveling
wire.summary: Renewed fighting has pushed Ethiopia's healthcare system close to collapse: "The whole emergency (room) was flooded with war trauma patients," one surgeon says of a brutal week in September.

wire.title: Get in, loser: Broadway's newest 'Mean Girls' are ready to insult (and enlighten) you
wire.summary: "School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play," is ending a Broadway run this week and celebrating with livestream broadcasts. We interviewed the Tony-nominated playwright, Jocelyn Bioh.

wire.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
wire.summary: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.

wire.title: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
wire.summary: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

wire.title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
wire.summary: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

wire.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
wire.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

wire.title: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
wire.summary: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.

wire.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
wire.summary: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.

wire.title: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
wire.summary: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.
